name: Govee Smart Bulb H6006 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth per Govee's spec list.

matter.note: Product page lists Matter control; CSA lists 'Govee RGBWW Smart LED Bulb' with family SKU H6008 and variant SKU H6006 (certificate CSA251E5MAT45367-24, 9 April 2025).

apple_home.note: Via Matter. Govee's Matter FAQ requires a Matter controller, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and IPv6 enabled on the router.

google_home.note: Govee lists Google Assistant voice control through its own integration; Matter is also possible.

alexa.note: Govee lists Alexa voice control through its own skill; Matter is also possible.

smartthings.note: Govee's SmartThings guide adds Matter devices by scanning the Matter QR code; a Matter-capable SmartThings hub is required.

home_assistant.note: The official Govee lights local integration lists the H6006. It uses Govee's LAN API, which must be enabled per device in the Govee Home app. Matter is an alternative.

hubRequired.note: For bulbs, this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. The H6006 connects over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth to the Govee Home app with no hub.

localControl.note: Home Assistant controls it over Govee's LAN API. Some users report the LAN toggle missing on their units, so check the app.

colorType.note: RGBWW: full colour plus white from 2700 to 6500 K.

lumens.note: 1000 lm at 9 W; Govee calls it a 75 W equivalent.

summary: Matter-certified over Wi-Fi, the Govee H6006 joins Apple Home and SmartThings as a Matter light, while Alexa and Google Home use Govee's own integrations. Home Assistant runs it locally through the official Govee lights local integration. You don't need a hub for the Govee Home app, which reaches the bulb over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. It's a US A19 bulb on an E26 base rated at 1000 lumens at 9 W (Govee calls it a 75 W equivalent), with full colour and white from 2700 to 6500 K.
caveats: Matter setup needs a Matter controller, 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and IPv6 enabled on your router.
SmartThings needs a Matter-capable SmartThings hub.
Home Assistant's local integration needs the LAN API switched on for each bulb in the Govee Home app, and some users report the toggle is missing.
